rules.qualitative_attenuation: derived action, resource, phase and audience sets must be subsets of the parent grant; expiry cannot extend; admin/delegation/scheduler bits require a named authority-root decision
rules.quantitative_conservation: spent + reserved_live + reclaimable <= root_ceiling for every quantitative dimension
rules.unknown: unknown or incomparable bounds, missing fences, or missing enforcement/effect receipts produce unavailable or model-gap
rules.receipt_non_substitution: authorization, enforcement, delivery, effect, denial, consumption and revocation receipts are not interchangeable

scenarios.pre_state: authority root confirms one finite graph with three read-only seats, one fan-in and aggregate budget 300
scenarios.path: root to child seats to fan-in
scenarios.current_status: conventional/partially observed; host tool confinement unknown
scenarios.expected: admit only within frozen graph and conserved aggregate budget

scenarios.pre_state: one workspace, explicit write paths, allowlisted test commands, no network or credentials, separate reviewer
scenarios.path: root to implementer tool/subprocess to reviewer
scenarios.current_status: unavailable as a proven fence on host/inherited profile
scenarios.expected: recommended V1 admit; current execution remains unproven until confinement evidence exists

scenarios.pre_state: draft and validation preview exist; no apply capability exists
scenarios.path: root to draft work to human gate
required_fences: absence of apply route represented honestly
scenarios.expected: approval records an approved draft and performs no authoritative mutation

scenarios.pre_state: two retries maximum; identical action/resource scope; decreasing remaining budget; exhaustion route
scenarios.path: execute to diagnose to repair loop
scenarios.expected: admit while counters and budget conserve; third retry denied

scenarios.pre_state: one idempotent effect with canonical command/target/payload digest, short capability and adapter reconciliation
scenarios.path: authority root to orchestrator to adapter to external system
scenarios.expected: gate then admit only with effect receipt; missing adapter proof yields unavailable, not inferred success

scenarios.pre_state: seat lacks issue/delegate authority but can call an issuer or receive a bearer token through context
scenarios.current_status: trust root and caller binding unproven
scenarios.expected: deny; token presence alone does not establish lawful ancestry

scenarios.pre_state: leaf has shell/tool access and attempts to launch, authorize or schedule work outside frozen plan
scenarios.current_status: no-spawn is requested, not an observed fence
scenarios.expected: deny in recommended V1; current status unknown/unavailable rather than safe

scenarios.pre_state: child output contains a graph, policy, tool profile or adapter configuration that a privileged consumer might execute
scenarios.expected: do not auto-promote; gate exact delta or deny

scenarios.pre_state: parallel seats or retries each reserve quota from the same stale root balance
scenarios.expected: admit only reservations within ceiling; reject stale/double allocation and record denial

scenarios.pre_state: approval or grant changes while operation is in flight, or child creates a fresh run claiming inherited token/context/budget
scenarios.current_status: partial recipient continuity; full authority continuity unproven
scenarios.expected: deny stale or inherited authority; uncertain external outcome routes to reconciliation

scenarios.pre_state: seat can read protected local data and changes model/provider/network destination or exports it through a tool
scenarios.current_status: host inherited environment does not prove mediation
scenarios.expected: deny undeclared egress; new provider/target requires exact gate

scenarios.pre_state: delivery receipt exists, cancellation arrives after dispatch, and compensation is attempted without a separate grant
scenarios.current_status: effect uniqueness and denial receipts incomplete
scenarios.expected: delivery is not success; reconcile; gate compensation independently
